settings.hero_headline:
Soft skin
that stays soft
all day long.
settings.hero_subheadline: Rich hydration that melts in, not on. No white cast, no greasy finish. Just the kind of skin you stop to notice in the mirror.
settings.problem_body: Most body butters sit on top of your skin, not inside it. Within hours, your skin drinks through whatever thin layer was left and you are back to dry, tight, and dull. You deserve better than reapplying three times a day.
settings.benefits_headline: Formulated to do more than feel good
settings.benefit_1_body: A rich butter base seals moisture at the skin level instead of evaporating off the surface. One application, hours of softness.
settings.benefit_2_body: Skin looks visibly softer and more even-toned after the first use. The kind of glow that makes people ask what you have been doing differently.
settings.benefit_3_body: Dense without being heavy. Absorbs quickly enough to get dressed right after. No transfer on your clothes, no slippery feel on your hands.
settings.benefit_4_title: Built for dry and ashy skin
settings.benefit_4_body: Formulated specifically for skin that tends to go dull fast. Works on elbows, knees, and anywhere else that needs serious attention.
